title: Windsong Farm

services.name: Horse Camp
services.desc: Camps are offered during spring break, summer, winter break, and most holidays. Campers will learn basic horse care and grooming, tacking up the horses, riding lessons or fun rides, games, outdoor activities, and arts & crafts. It's a great way to stay active, make new friends, and enjoy being outside. Each Camper will be assigned his or her own Pony/Horse for the week of camp. Campers will also learn how to handle and care for other farm animals. We will provide lunch and snacks. Each child must bring their own water bottle with the ability to refill at the farm. A riding helmet (We have riding helmets to use if your child does not have one - a bicycle helmet is not sufficient) Camp
